title: Compact quickstart cards for structured output / JSON schema guide
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and produce a compact set of onboarding 'quickstart' cards that teach users how to provide JSON schema and use the Structured Output features. Deliverables: (1) three card sizes (compact / cozy / expanded) for the Console quickstart panel, (2) annotated screenshots for release notes and docs, (3) interactive validation UI mockups showing inline errors, suggested fixes, and sample payload previews, and (4) exportable assets for engineering and marketing (PNG, SVG, Figma link). Focus on progressive disclosure: start simple with a one-line schema example and allow a single tap to expand into advanced validation tips and sample responses.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 3 card layouts prepared and reviewed in Figma (compact, cozy, expanded)
Annotated console screenshots for dark and light mode exported at 2x for docs and release notes
Interactive validation UI flows documented: invalid schema state, quick-fix suggestions, live example toggle
Design handoff assets (Figma file, component tokens, export ZIP) linked and accessible to engineering
Microcopy for validation errors reviewed by PM and localization team
decisions: Use compact card as default on first-run modal to reduce cognitive load
Introduce a single 'Show advanced validation' control instead of multiple toggles to keep visual density low
Prefer inline chips for field-level errors rather than modal dialogs to keep user context
notes: Trade-offs: compact cards use abbreviated examples which may omit edge-case guidance; resolved by adding 'view sample responses' expansion
Performance: exported screenshots should avoid heavy shadows to reduce file size for docs page load
Accessibility: all cards must meet AA contrast; validation colorings paired with icons for colorblind users
